qualifier: cyclooxygenase branch
name: Cyclooxygenase-dependent prostanoid synthesis and receptor signaling
rationale: All members concern PLA2-released arachidonate conversion by COX to prostaglandins/thromboxanes and their receptors, distinguishing it from the leukotriene/lipoxygenase confusables and from the GO prostaglandin-regulation confusables.

qualifier: germinal center, memory and plasma cell
name: B lineage development, germinal center and plasma cell differentiation
rationale: Members are B cell signatures and development/differentiation terms through germinal center, memory and plasma cell stages (with Tfh/ICOS help), whereas confusables center on proximal BCR/TCR signaling, thymic T cell selection or isotype switching.

qualifier: JNK/p38 regulation with AP-1 immediate-early response
name: JNK/p38 stress kinase regulation and AP-1 immediate-early response
rationale: Members regulate TAK1-driven JNK/p38 cascades and AP-1/immediate-early (NR4A, TNF-NF-kB) transcription, separating it from UV/nitric-oxide stress responses, ERK negative feedback and NOD receptor signaling confusables.

qualifier: chylomicron/VLDL assembly and HDL/LDL remodeling
name: Chylomicron and VLDL assembly with lipoprotein remodeling
rationale: All members concern assembly, remodeling and clearance of plasma lipoprotein particles, with assembly of chylomicrons/VLDL and HDL/LDL remodeling absent from the lipase- and LDL-clearance-focused confusables.

qualifier: SHC1, GRB2 and PI3K adaptor events
name: ERBB receptor SHC1, GRB2 and PI3K adaptor signaling
rationale: Members are EGFR/ERBB2/ERBB3/ERBB4 signaling via SHC1, GRB2 and PI3K adaptors, unlike confusables covering PLCG1/GRB7/PTK6 events, ERBB4 nuclear signaling or MET signaling.

qualifier: T cell tolerance and NK cell activation
name: Immunoregulatory receptors in T cell tolerance and NK activation
rationale: Members concern co-stimulatory/inhibitory receptor control of T cell costimulation, anergy and tolerance, dendritic cell activation and KIR-type NK receptors, while confusables lack the NK/tolerance arm or focus on Treg differentiation or NK cytotoxicity.

qualifier: developmental and activity-dependent
name: Skeletal muscle development and activity-dependent adaptation
rationale: Members cover skeletal muscle differentiation, diaphragm/extraocular muscle development and responses to activity, inactivity and atrophy, unlike confusables on cardiac adaptation, cell size or sarcomere contraction.

qualifier: ependymal multiciliogenesis, CSF flow and sperm motility
name: Ependymal multiciliogenesis, CSF flow and sperm motility
rationale: Members concern motile cilia: multiciliogenesis and basal body/centriole assembly underlying ventricular CSF circulation, plus sperm flagellar motility, whereas confusables focus on axonemal dynein arm assembly and mucociliary clearance.

qualifier: RNA polymerase III and snRNA initiation
name: RNA polymerase III and snRNA transcription initiation
rationale: Members are Pol III promoter-type initiation, tRNA transcription and Pol II/III snRNA transcription, while confusables cover Pol III elongation/termination and rRNA transcription and processing.

qualifier: adhesion receptor-driven activation, degranulation and aggregation
name: Platelet activation, degranulation and aggregation via adhesion receptors
rationale: Members concern platelet activation, adhesion to collagen via GPVI/GPIb-IX-V, PECAM1, degranulation and coagulation, distinguishing it from VWF variant, ADP-P2Y and thrombin/thromboxane receptor confusables.

qualifier: defensins in intestinal epithelial and microbiota homeostasis
name: Defensin antimicrobial peptides in intestinal epithelial and microbiota homeostasis
rationale: Members concern alpha/beta-defensin and antimicrobial peptide production linked to intestinal stem cell and epithelial maintenance and microbiota shaping, which neither the broad antimicrobial-humoral confusables nor the intestinal-epithelium confusable combine.

qualifier: decapping, deadenylation-independent
name: Deadenylation-independent decapping and 5'-to-3' mRNA decay
rationale: All three members describe cap removal and XRN-mediated 5'-to-3' mRNA degradation, distinct from deadenylation, ARE-binding-protein and snRNA cap confusables.

qualifier: non-oxidative pentose phosphate and xylulose 5-phosphate
name: Non-oxidative pentose phosphate and xylulose 5-phosphate metabolism
rationale: Members cover the non-oxidative pentose phosphate shunt (RPIA/TALDO1 defects) and glucuronate-to-xylulose 5-phosphate pentose metabolism, unlike fructose, glycerol and galactose confusables.

qualifier: SMO activation and proteasomal GLI/DVL turnover
name: Hedgehog SMO–GLI transduction and proteasomal GLI/DVL turnover
rationale: Members concern SMO activation, ciliary localization and proteasomal GLI processing/degradation plus DVL degradation, separating it from Hh ligand processing, planar cell polarity and canonical Wnt/Notch confusables.

qualifier: OTU-family, K11/K48-linked
name: OTU-family K11/K48-linked protein deubiquitination
rationale: Members are OTU domain proteases and K11/K48-linked deubiquitination, distinct from USP/UCH/Josephin DUB, NF-kB regulation and ubiquitin chain synthesis confusables.

core: Bacterial subversion of host cell defenses
qualifier: mycobacterial immune evasion and Listeria InlB entry
name: Mycobacterial host defense subversion and Listeria InlB-mediated entry
rationale: Members describe Mtb suppression of autophagy, apoptosis, NO, membrane repair and phagolysosome fusion plus Gram-positive (Listeria InlB) host cell entry, whereas confusables cover phagosome acidification, iron assimilation, toxins or InlA epithelial attachment.

core: Type I interferon induction by dsRNA
qualifier: RIG-I/MDA5 and TLR3 via TBK1–IRF3
name: dsRNA-triggered TBK1–IRF3 type I interferon induction
rationale: Members concern RIG-I/MDA5 and TLR3 dsRNA sensing leading to TBK1/IKKε activation of IRF3/IRF7 and type I IFN, unlike confusables on ISG effector responses, NF-kB/TRAF6 arms or cGAS-STING.

qualifier: TGF-beta/activin receptors, SMAD2/3 and cancer mutants
name: TGF-beta/activin receptor–SMAD2/3 signaling and its cancer mutants
rationale: Members span TGFBR1/2/3 and activin/AMH receptor signaling, SMAD2/3:SMAD4 transcription with RUNX3 targets and their cancer mutants, distinct from BMP, MET and Hippo-YAP confusables.

qualifier: synthesis, transport and receptor signaling
name: Thyroid hormone synthesis, transport and receptor signaling
rationale: All members concern thyroid hormone generation, transport, activity and receptor response, separating it from growth hormone, selenium metabolism and peroxide confusables.

qualifier: semaphorin–plexin repulsion and growth-cone collapse
name: Semaphorin–plexin signaling in axon repulsion and growth-cone collapse
rationale: Members are semaphorin (Sema3A/Sema4D)–plexin signaling via CRMPs, PAK and RND1 driving axon repulsion and growth-cone collapse, unlike netrin- and ephrin-based guidance confusables.

qualifier: classical pathway, C3/C5 cleavage and opsonization
name: Classical complement activation, C3/C5 cleavage and opsonization
rationale: Members describe antibody/GZMK-initiated complement activation through C3/C5 and opsonization, whereas confusables center on the alternative pathway and complement regulation.

qualifier: SREBP-driven, ER sterol transport
name: SREBP-regulated cholesterol biosynthesis and ER sterol transport
rationale: Members concern SREBP target activation, cholesterol homeostasis and ER/vesicular sterol transport, distinct from fatty acid homeostasis, reverse cholesterol transport, ATF6/CREB3 and nuclear receptor confusables.

qualifier: phenylalanine/tyrosine with tetrahydrobiopterin cofactor
name: Phenylalanine and tyrosine catabolism with tetrahydrobiopterin synthesis
rationale: Members cover phenylalanine/tyrosine metabolism, phenylketonuria and BH4 cofactor synthesis, while confusables are generic amino acid terms or sulfur/vitamin B6/molybdenum metabolism.

qualifier: integrin- and S1P-dependent, secondary/mucosal lymphoid organs
name: Integrin-dependent lymphocyte homing and secondary lymphoid tissue development
rationale: Members concern integrin- and S1P-mediated lymphocyte homing to lymph nodes and gut-associated lymphoid tissue with lymphoid organ development, unlike confusables on immunological synapse, extravasation or chemokine signaling.

qualifier: CD1 and NKT cell activation
name: CD1 lipid antigen presentation and NKT cell activation
rationale: Members concern CD1/MHC class Ib lipid antigen presentation and NKT cell activation, differentiation and proliferation, distinguishing it from MHC class II peptide presentation, monocyte and Th1/IL-12 confusables.
